# NETSOL Technologies expands digital retail footprint as Jim Ellis Automotive Group signs up for Transcend Retail


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_c8bc9e83c66409b3b279f8a4b8797680/netsoltech/news/2026-11-19_NETSOL_Technologies_expands_digital_retail_3274.pdf) November 19, 2026


### Jim Ellis Automotive Group’s Genesis of Atlanta to connect online and showroom buying experience as Transcend Retail go-live approaches


ENCINO, Calif., Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NETSOL Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: NTWK), a provider of AI-enabled solutions and services powering OEMs, dealerships and financial institutions to sell, finance and lease assets, today announced that Jim Ellis Automotive Group’s Genesis of Atlanta has signed on to implement Transcend Retail, with go-live planned for the near term.


Genesis of Atlanta is operated by Jim Ellis Automotive Group, a family-owned dealer group serving the Atlanta metro area since 1971. Its move to Transcend Retail will bring a connected buying experience to its customers once the platform goes live.


“We selected NETSOL after a detailed evaluation process,” said Frank Dickenson, General Manager of Genesis of Atlanta. “Our vision is to eliminate unnecessary paperwork, simplify the transaction and give our customers a seamless experience whether they’re shopping online or sitting in our showroom. We believe Transcend Retail and our partnership with NETSOL will help us set a new standard for automotive retail.”


“Today’s dealers need more than another digital tool,” said Najeeb Ghauri, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of NETSOL Technologies, Inc. “They need a connected retail platform that eliminates friction, creates transparency and empowers their teams to deliver a better customer experience. We’re pleased to welcome Jim Ellis Automotive Group’s Genesis of Atlanta, and we look forward to supporting their team as they bring Transcend Retail to their customers.”


Transcend Retail is designed to connect the consumer and dealership throughout the purchasing journey, bringing together online shopping, in-store desking, financing and transaction management within a unified digital platform.


**About NETSOL Technologies**
NETSOL Technologies delivers state-of-the-art solutions for asset finance, leasing and digital automotive retail, serving automotive and equipment OEMs, dealerships, auto captives and financial institutions across over 30 countries. Since its inception in 1997, NETSOL has been at the cutting edge of technology, pioneering innovations with its asset finance solutions, and today leverages advanced AI and cloud services to meet the complex needs of the global market. Renowned for its deep industry expertise, customer-centric approach and commitment to excellence, NETSOL fosters strong partnerships with its customers, ensuring their success in an ever-evolving landscape. With a rich history of innovation, ethical business practices and a focus on sustainability, NETSOL is dedicated to empowering businesses worldwide, securing its position as the trusted partner for leading firms around the globe.
